record.question: Who are the member Countries of BIMSTEC?
options: Bangladesh, India, Myanmar, Sri Lanka, Thailand, England, China Economic Co-operation
Bangladesh, India, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, England, China Economic Co-operation
Bangladesh, India, Myanmar, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Nepal and Bhutan Economic Co-operation
Bangladesh, India, Maldives, Singapore and Thailand Economic Co-operation
record.explanation: Answer C: Bangladesh, India, Myanmar, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Nepal and Bhutan Economic Co-operation. BIMSTEC comprises Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka and Thailand; option (c) lists those seven members (despite awkward appended wording). Reference: https://bimstec.org/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
